description: Provides analytical insights and aggregated data related to partners, including activity trends, user-specific partner associations, and geographic distribution.

endpoints.name: GetMostActivePartners
endpoints.description: Retrieves the most active partners based on engagement count, interaction count, or recent activity.

limit.description: Maximum number of partners to return (default: 10)

timeframe.description: Time period to analyze (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly)

metric.description: Activity metric to measure (engagements, interactions, lastActivity)

example_uses: Show most active partners this month
Get top 5 partners by engagement count
Show partners with highest engagement in the last quarter
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when you need to identify the most active or engaged partners based on various metrics.

endpoints.name: GetPartnersByUser
endpoints.description: Retrieves partners created or managed by a specific user with activity metrics.

userId.description: User ID to get partners for

timeframe.description: Time period to analyze (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly)

includeCreated.description: Include partners created by the user (default: true)

includeModified.description: Include partners modified by the user (default: true)

includeFocalPoint.description: Include partners where user is focal point (default: true)

example_uses: Show all partners created by user 123
Get partners managed by specific user
List partners modified by user 456 this month
Find partners where user 789 is the focal point
Show all partner activity for a specific user
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when you need to see all partners associated with a specific user's activities.

endpoints.name: GetEngagementTrends
endpoints.description: Retrieves historical engagement trends for partners over a specified period.

period.description: Time period for trend analysis (e.g., monthly, quarterly)

months.description: Number of months to include in the trend analysis

partnerId.description: Optional Partner ID to filter engagement trends for a specific partner

example_uses: Show engagement trends for the last 12 months.
Get quarterly engagement trends for partner 123.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this to understand how partner engagement has evolved over time, either overall or for a specific partner.

endpoints.name: GetPartnersByCountry
endpoints.description: Retrieves partners grouped by country with counts and metrics.

limit.description: Maximum number of countries to return (default: 20)

minCount.description: Minimum number of partners per country to include (default: 1)

example_uses: List top countries by partner count
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when you need to analyze the geographic distribution of partners.
